summary.text: Tanya Miller is the Democratic nominee for Attorney General of Georgia. A trial lawyer and former prosecutor, she has represented Georgia House District 62 since 2023 and is the House Democratic Caucus Chair.

paragraphs.text: Earned a J.D. from Case Western Reserve University.
Worked as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New York, a Fulton County prosecutor handling homicides and crimes against women and children, and as a civil rights and criminal defense lawyer.
Elected to the Georgia House in 2022 (took office January 2023); elected House Democratic Caucus Chair in 2024. Serves as General Counsel to the Georgia Federation of Public Service Employees.
